'''Muntanye''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who served under [[Supreme Commander]] [[Jace Malcom]] during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Muntannye reported to the Supreme Commander on the status of refugee [[Whiteraft|caravan 47-B]], codenamed "Whiteraft," which unbeknownst to the Republic had been stopped by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in order to acquire several [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from the caravan.<ref name="TOR" />
